calls.reason: GPT-NeoX released code and weights, Stanford demonstrated cheap Alpaca adaptation, and The Verge verified leaked LLaMA weights. These support the main point of irreversible diffusion, though literal dark-web availability remains unverified.

Watermark studies show defensive strengths and vulnerabilities, and OpenAI reports disrupting influence operations. These do not clearly establish repeated operational adaptation or how difficult combating misinformation has become.

AI Impacts establishes substantial researcher concern, while Monmouth finds majority public concern and support for regulation. Neither measures whether most people actually behaved as if those risks did not matter.
